notes.title: LoveSoTea demo slightly updated!
notes.notes:
We’ve made a small update to the short demo released in February — now you can play a bit longer!

🎮 A tea-brewing simulation
👼 A quiet story of guiding two souls: a high school student and a man with only a little time left.

Changes from Demo ver0.1 (Feb release):
⏳ Play time: around 10 → 15 minutes
📅 3 more in-game days added
💬 Added a few new dialogues
🌏 Fixed some missing translations
🙇 Other minor bug fixes

Known issue:
Sometimes, the spoon may be hard to grab. Try clicking around or picking it up again 🙇

Sharing screenshots or videos of the game on social media really encourages us!
※ Feel free to post as long as it's within the bounds of fair use.

Especially if you can share it on global platforms like Reddit, Tumblr, TikTok, or Instagram, it would mean a lot — I often find it hard to reach these places, so your support is truly appreciated!

📋 Feedback Survey
We’d love to hear your thoughts!
The survey is available in 4 languages: Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese.

https://forms.gle/HXf2SpFZT1vUdUgh8

A longer demo is planned for this autumn.
Please wishlist the game and follow us on Twitter 🙇

notes.title: "LoveSoTea" Short Demo Now Available!
notes.notes:
[b]⏳ Playtime: About 10 minutes
🫖 A tea-brewing simulation
💫 A quiet story of guiding two young men—one with little time left, and a high school student[/b]

[b]About the Demo[/b]
In this short demo, you can experience the basics of brewing tea.
The final game may differ from this version, but we hope you enjoy a glimpse of its world! ✨

[b]Streaming, Fan Works, & Social Media[/b]
🎥 Streaming is OK!
🖌 Fan works are welcome!
📢 Feel free to post and share on social media!

We’d love to see your screenshots and gameplay clips!
※ Feel free to share as long as it stays within reasonable fair use guidelines.

[b]Survey Request[/b]
If you play the demo, we’d really appreciate it if you could fill out our survey!
🌏 The survey is available in 4 languages (Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese).

Since this demo was translated with some automated assistance, there may be slight awkwardness in some parts.
If you notice anything that feels off, please let us know through the survey!

notes.title: Official Doujinshi Tea-duo Manga Now on Kindle!
notes.notes:
📕 We're excited to announce the release of Tea-duo, the official doujinshi manga for LoveSoTea, now available on Kindle for $1.99 (20 pages)!

In this 4-panel comic, follow the story of a melancholy young man and a high school student who insists on sharing delicious tea with him. Even if you’re new to LoveSoTea (which, by the way, is still in full development), you’ll be able to dive right into this quirky tea-time tale—no game knowledge required...probably!

Thank you to everyone who’s already grabbed a copy! 🙏 As a solo creator, I can see the number of copies sold, and your support really means a lot!

Kindle:[url=https://www.amazon.com/Tea-duo-LoveSoTea-MIYAKO-publ-ebook/dp/B0DHLWRZ7Z]https://www.amazon.com/Tea-duo-LoveSoTea-MIYAKO-publ-ebook/dp/B0DHLWRZ7Z[/url]

Note: Translations were supported by AI, so if you spot any strange wording, please let me know!
